cpf-frs.title: CPF-001: CPF Retirement Sum (made up)
cpf-frs.content: The Full Retirement Sum (FRS) for members turning 55 in 2026 is $205,800. Members may withdraw amounts above the FRS.

cpf-withdrawal.title: CPF-002: CPF Withdrawal at 55 (made up)
cpf-withdrawal.content: Members can apply online via CPF website using Singpass, or at any CPF Service Centre with NRIC.

cpf-life.title: CPF-003: CPF LIFE Payouts (made up)
cpf-life.content: CPF LIFE provides monthly payouts from age 65 for life. Payout depends on Retirement Account balance.

medisave.title: CPF-004: Medisave Withdrawal (made up)
medisave.content: You may use Medisave for approved medical expenses for yourself, spouse, children, parents, grandparents, and siblings.
